# Columns, tab-separated: from, to, kind, figure, access, where.
#   kind    owns (holds it by value, in a container or through unique_ptr / new), reads (holds or takes it without
#           owning it), makes (constructs or returns it), links (CMake link line or Python import; libraries only)
#   access  for reads: const (const &, const *, shared_ptr<const>) or nonconst (the code passes a non-const pointer
#           or reference; drawn with the label "nc"); empty otherwise
#   where   the member, argument or call that backs the arrow
